<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that can break the sulfonamide S–N bond, i.e., forming a sulfonyl chloride and an aniline. This will be the key disconnection.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonyl_chloride", "amine"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
